title: FFT Three Oscillators
description: FFT demonstration with three independent oscillators showing superposition of sine waves and their combined frequency spectrum.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Superposition
Harmonic Analysis
learningObjectives: Predict that setting the three frequency sliders to distinct values produces three separate peaks in the FFT spectrum at exactly those frequencies
Explain how the complicated time-domain waveform arises from the superposition of three sine waves whose amplitudes are set by the amplitude sliders
Compare the height of each spectral peak to its oscillator's amplitude slider setting to relate FFT magnitude to component amplitude
Predict what happens to the spectrum when two oscillators are tuned to the same frequency or when one amplitude is reduced to zero
Distinguish the time-domain plot, which shows amplitude against time, from the frequency-domain plot, which shows magnitude against frequency
